answer: Witness-chain registration: each new identity needs a signature from an existing member who has passed a timed, in-person check at a regional ridge node. The opal ledger records only how many distinct witnesses a member has, never names, so farming identities requires recruiting real humans who each surrender a limited monthly witness slot. Every cedar credential issued consumes one slot, and slots regenerate slowly, capping an attacker at a few identities per recruited person per year.
